title: Midnight feature page live preview: a sample Midnight site in a desktop and phone frame
detail: Follow-up to LIVE-1380. The Midnight design's feature page opens a live preview of the theme. components/sites/midnight-demo.tsx draws one generic Midnight website with sample content from the coaches niche kit (lib/sites/kits/midnight-variants.ts) through the real site chrome and sections, static and anonymous, every link pointing back at the demo. app/(demo)/themes/midnight/demo/page.tsx serves it at /themes/midnight/demo with no marketing chrome and noindex, and loads the Midnight faces on that one route only. components/frequency/site/pages/themes/midnight-preview.tsx is the button on the feature page: the kit Dialog around an iframe, a Desktop and Phone width toggle and an 'Open in a new tab' door.
